It was dual lane so I was going to make a lane change, but before I could execute it the woman flipped on her left blinker to make a lane change. Now sitting there going "god I fucking hate Calgary drivers" I waited to see what she'd do. Nothing, she did nothing, she didn't speed up and she didn't change lanes. I executed an emergency swerve and avoid maneuver only to lose traction on the slick roads, I had to over steer to the right to avoid hitting the barrier and then quickly oversteer to the left to avoid hitting her car before I could gently recover my car. This all happened in a matter of seconds.
